title: ExecutionBrief
description: Contract written by the orchestrator before dispatching a wave. Headless agents MUST NOT execute without a valid brief.

wave_id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Must match the branch name suffix (wave/<wave_id>).

environment.description: Execution environment. Determines which scope tiers are permitted.

tier.description: mechanically-computable: deterministic pass/fail (tsc, go test, vitest, headless xcodebuild). visual-sensory: requires iOS Simulator, gesture evaluation, or device testing. Headless VMs MUST use mechanically-computable.

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns for files the agent may modify (e.g. 'observer/**', 'DeriveeWeb/**'). Agent MUST NOT touch files outside these globs.

banned_paths.description: Glob patterns the agent must never touch, even if they fall within allowed_paths.

verification_commands.description: Shell commands that must all exit 0 for the wave to pass. Example: ['tsc --noEmit', 'go test ./...']

budget_tokens.description: Hard token budget for this wave. Evidence floor (2026-10-06 usage analysis): zero real waves shipped under 250k tokens; a budget below the harness's minimum viable cost kills the agent mid-exploration with full spend and zero code. Agent must halt if exceeded.

max_attempts.description: Maximum code-modifying attempts. Recon passes do not count.

max_lines_changed.description: Optional hard cap on total lines changed (insertions + deletions).

timeout_minutes.description: Wall-clock timeout. Agent must emit receipt and halt after this duration.

branch_policy.description: wave-branch: commit to wave/<wave_id> branch (required for headless-vm). patch-only: emit .patch file only, no commits. direct-main: push to main (local-mac only, requires Walsh present).

acceptance.description: Human-readable acceptance criteria. Each must be a positive assertion of target state, never 'absence of error'.

kill_conditions.description: Conditions under which the agent must immediately halt and emit a failed receipt. Example: 'Any file outside allowed_paths is modified', 'Token burn exceeds budget_tokens'.

blast_radius_files.description: Files identified during recon as needing modification.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions from recon that may require Walsh's input.

recon_output.description: Output from a prior recon pass. Required for waves with max_attempts > 1.

path.description: Path to the implementation plan markdown (loops/templates/implementation-plan.md format), relative to the audits root (~/workspace/derivee-audits/). Example: 'plans/geocode-finish-plan.md'.

commit.description: Repo commit the plan was written against. The agent re-validates the plan if the tree has moved past this commit.

plan_artifact.description: Orchestrator-written implementation plan. The dispatch prompt MUST instruct the agent to validate this plan against the code as step 1; a disproved plan is a kill condition (halt + failed receipt), never an invitation to improvise.

approved_by.description: walsh-explicit: Walsh named this wave. convergence-list: wave is on the approved convergence list in 80H-PROVING-PLAN.md §3.
